annotation.title_clean: Study on an Operation Regulation Framework under International Humanitarian Law for Sentry Robots
annotation.title_en: Study on an Operation Regulation Framework under International Humanitarian Law for Sentry Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Tsujita, T.; Sakuma, Y.; Yamada, S.; Eto, R.; Kurosaki, M.
annotation.venue: Journal of the Robotics Society of Japan
annotation.summary_en: Short engineering-legal paper interpreting International Humanitarian Law (Additional Protocol I) to propose an operation framework for sentry robots protecting civilians from suicide bombings. It defines legal indicators (certainty, effort, nexus possibility, necessity, collateral damage) tied to distinction, proportionality and precaution, validated on a real robot with human-in-the-loop.
key_provisions_or_claims: Interprets AP I articles on distinction, proportionality and precaution for robotic systems
Proposes legal indicators: certainty, effort, nexus possibility, necessity, collateral damage
Framework keeps a human in the loop for lethal decisions
Validated experimentally with a Husky-based sentry robot using terahertz camera and LiDAR
Aims to protect civilians and conflict parties from suicide bombings
